hub.title: Akalola ka account
hub.description: Sungileni ama-order, ifyasungwa, delivery, na ifyo Vergeo5 ilanguka.
hub.ordersBody: Loleni delivery, pickup, na payment pa ushitisha cila umo.
hub.recentEmpty: Ama-product yo mulemona yakalanguka pano pa device.
hub.addressesBody: Ama-landmark na GPS pakuti checkout iyampe bwangu.
hub.helpBody: Amashinda pa ama-order, payment, na account.
hub.deviceNote: Ifyasungwa na recently viewed fisungwa pa device ili. Tefi stock nangu price hold.
hub.vendorPortalBody: Sungileni listings, orders, na payouts mu vendor portal.

saved.title: Ifyasungwa
saved.description: Ama-product yo mwasungile. Yaisa pa device ili.
saved.disclaimer: Ukusunga item tefyo kuletekele stock nangu price.
saved.emptyBody: Tina heart pa product pakuti musunge pa device ili.
saved.loadError: Tatwaishibe ukuleta product. Wesheni nangu fye.
saved.signedOutNote: Mungasunga items pantu mwiingile. Ingileni pakuti musunge ama-order na addresses.

recent.title: Ifyo mwacitile view limbi
recent.description: History iipi ya ama-product ayaisulwa pa device ili.
recent.privacyNote: Yasungwa fye pa browser iyi. Taikwata sync. Mungaisula inshita ili yonse.
recent.emptyBody: Isuleni product page pakuti ilanguke pano.

following.title: Following
following.description: New arrivals from the stores you follow, from the last 30 days.
following.emptyBody: Follow stores you like and their new products will show up here.
following.signIn: Sign in to see the stores you follow
following.loadFailed: Couldn't load your feed. Try again.
following.viewFeed: See new from stores you follow

deliveryConsent.title: Ukwabana amashina ne ba delivery
deliveryConsent.description: Vergeo5 ibomfya ama-courier ayakwata licence pa ma-delivery yamo. Pa kuleta order yenu, courier alefwaya ishina lyenu, nambala ya foni ne address ya delivery. Tulabapeela fye nga mwasuminisha. Pickup tailefwaya ifi.
deliveryConsent.label: Peeleni courier ishina lyandi, foni ne address pa kuleta ama-order yandi
deliveryConsent.grantedAt: Mwasuminishe pa {at}. Kuti mwaleka ilyo lyonse.
deliveryConsent.notGranted: Tamusuminishe. Abantu ba Vergeo5 balaleta order beka, nangu balamwipusha ilyo bashilabomfya courier.
deliveryConsent.loadFailed: Twafilwa ukusanga ifyo mwasala. Esheni na kabili.
deliveryConsent.saveFailed: Twafilwa ukusunga ifyo mwasala. Esheni na kabili.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Tumwafwe ukusuma Vergeo5 pa kutwebelela ukumona ifyo mubomfya, nga amapeji mwingila.
analytics.on: Kuli: tulemona amapeji mwingila, kabili panuma ya kwingila tulemulumanya ku akaunti yenu. Ifilumanya fisulwa panuma ya matazi 30.
analytics.off: Cilekwa: tusunga fye ubwingi bwa bantu (anonymous counts), nga bangaye bamona peji. Takuli ifyo mwacita ifisungwa, kabili takuli cilumenwe kuli imwe.
analytics.gpc: Browser yenu iletuma Global Privacy Control, ico analytics ilekwa. Tulesunga ico browser yenu ilanda.

birthday.title: Ubushiku bwenu ubwa kufyalwa (te kuti mufwile)
birthday.intro: Tell us your birthday for a treat each year. We only need the day and month.
birthday.yearHelp: Leave empty if you prefer. We never show it.
birthday.consent: Yes, send me a birthday treat each year. I can stop this any time.
birthday.saved: Saved. Look out for a treat on your birthday.
birthday.changeFrom: You can change the date again from {date}.
birthday.removed: Removed. We won't send birthday messages.
birthday.privacy: Every birthday message has a way to stop them.

errors.generic: We couldn't save your birthday. Try again.
errors.consent: Tick the first box to get a birthday treat.
errors.adult: Birthday treats are for people aged 18 or older.
errors.minor: Birthday treats are for people aged 18 or older.
errors.changeLocked: You changed your birthday recently. Try again later.
errors.tooMany: Too many changes. Try again later.

rewards.howOrders: ⚠ 1 point for every K1 you pay, added once your order is delivered and the return window has passed.
rewards.howReviews: ⚠ Points for every verified review, whatever stars you give. A photo earns a little more.
